Name: Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for MGC
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[size=3][font=Arial]Oh hi!

If you’re a Seasonal Cute Characters fan like me - I’ve made a cute sprite and portrait mod for Cambria from MGC.

This mod REQUIRES MGC, Content Patcher, and SMAPI. 

I RECOMMEND you download Poltergeister's[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450] Vanilla [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]ES[/url] seasonal cute character mods, as well as my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012]East Scarp Remastered [/url]mod for a unified look!
﻿
Installation:[/font]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]download the mod[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Arial]
Features:[/font]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]configurable noses[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]cute sprites and portraits for Cambria![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Arial]If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it - I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps!

If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/drawberry138]here[/url]! I'd really appreciate it :)

I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care, Drawberry xo

Special thanks to: [/font]
